Subject: Evidence request: cross-region HSM rotation windows, TLS wrap proofs, and operator custody

Hi Markus,

AuroraFin is in the homestretch of our SOC 2 readiness review and we need to validate a few items tied to key custody and rotation for your tenant. Can you provide the following by EOD Friday (2028-11-24)?

1) A short inventory showing which HSM/KMS instances are used for tenant key wrapping (region, instance id, responsible operator role).
2) Rotation schedule and the last three rotation events (timestamps, operator id, brief justification).
3) Sample operator shift logs around the most recent rotation window (redact PII where appropriate).
4) The most recent HSM attestation or vendor-signed proof of tamper state (PDF).
5) Confirmation of in-transit protection for key-wrapping channels (TLS ciphers and any envelope-wrapping metadata).

If you have a one-page manifest or a preferred delivery bundle (SFTP/Drive link, HubSpot ticket), send that and we can coordinate secure upload. If you can’t meet EOD Friday, propose a date and we’ll adjust the audit timeline accordingly.

Thanks,
Julie

Hi Julie — quick status update and samples attached inline.

Inventory (high level):
- us-west-2-hsm-01 (primary wrap; vendor: SafeHSM Co., model S-9000) — tenants: AuroraFin-prod; operator group: crypt-ops
- us-east-1-kms-03 (envelope key service; vendor cloud-km) — used for ephemeral wrapping when cross-region transfers occur

Rotation events (last three):
- 2028-08-12T02:14:23Z — manual rotation (scheduled maintenance) — operator: crypt-ops-shift-14 (role: senior-crypto-operator)
- 2028-05-10T01:48:11Z — automated rolling rotation (sequence id 3421) — operator: system (automated schedule)
- 2027-11-09T22:03:05Z — emergency rewrap following vendor firmware patch — operator: crypt-ops-shift-03

Attached are: hsm_attestation_2028Q3.pdf (vendor signed page extracted) and rotation_logs_sample.tar.gz (contains sanitized shiftlog excerpt). We omitted full operator emails and replaced operator identifiers with role+shift id to preserve privacy while maintaining auditability.

Notes on TLS/envelope wrapping:
- All inter-region transport uses TLS1.3 with AEAD ciphers (TLS_AES_256_GCM_SHA384) and ephemeral ECDHE key exchange.
- Envelope wrapping uses HSM-protected KEK (RSA-4096 wrap), with the final wrap stored on the tenant keystore and a separate KEK in the regional HSM for emergency unwrap (key escrow policy documented).

If Aurora needs signature verification details for the attestation, we can provide the vendor verification chain and chain-of-trust manifest.

Thanks — attaching the files to the secure Drive link below and copying the HubSpot ticket for tracking.

Marissa Cole
Security Operations
